name.description: Short display name for this session.

summary.description: One-sentence description of the session's purpose.

agent.description: VS Code chat-mode name bound to this session (e.g. 'syspilot.cm' or 'Change Manager' — identity may be filename-stem or frontmatter name with spaces, per SPEC_SES_AGENT_DISCOVERY). When set, opening the session activates that chat agent automatically.
